rollforward.distribution_paid_declared_note: No single declared-for-year subtotal is disclosed inside the audited Distribution Statement (it lists paid tranches only). The declared-for-FY24/25 figure (S$385,979k / DPU 13.57c) appears only in Financial Highlights, which is out of audited scope per constraints, so nulled here.
rollforward.notes: Guard A+B-P = 101,328 + 388,110 - 385,455 = 103,983 (thousands) != E 117,337; gap = exactly 13,354. This is NOT a misread. The Distribution Statement (p125) credits an additional separate for-year line 'Distribution of gains from divestment' of 13,354 (capital-gains top-up, incl. Tanglin Halt Cluster net divestment gain) to the distributable pool. Full audited identity holds exactly: A + B + 13,354 (divestment gains) - P = 101,328 + 388,110 + 13,354 - 385,455 = 117,337 = E. All four A/B/P/E lines read verbatim from the audited Group column, p125.

txns.gain_basis: Disclosed discount at acquisition: agreed property value JPY14.5bn = approximately 3.3% discount to JLL Morii Valuation & Advisory K.K.'s independent valuation of JPY15.0bn. FLAG: this % is sourced from the AR Operations Review narrative (p32), not the audited FS. Acquisition context, so a discount is favourable to buyer (negative sign). Audited cross-check (vs_valuation): SGD acquisition cost 131,341 vs Portfolio Statement valuation 135,272 as at 31/03/2025 = -2.9% (different valuation date/currency, corroborates the ~3% discount).
